I don't know how much longer we can hold out...|Jundland Station representative to Echuu Shen-Jon|<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>}}
'''Jundland Station''' was a settlement on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] located near [[Mos Osnoe]], [[Boorka's Palace]], and the [[Confederacy way station]]. It was either located at the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on Tatooine, or was otherwise named after it. The Jundland Station included housing, speeders, a downed starship, and a [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr]] Monastery.<ref name="CC" />

==History==
During the [[Second Battle of Tatooine]], Jundland Station was visited by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Naat Reath]] after their meeting with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], concerning the alliance between [[Boorka]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. The citizens of Jundland Station asked Echuu and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces to destroy the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] that had been harassing the settlement. Agreeing to help them, Echuu and his troops wiped out the nearby Tusken [[Unidentified Tusken Raider camp (Jundland Station)|village]], destroying all of their tents and killing all men, women, and children. In their gratitude, the villagers rewarded the Republic forces with resources and [[Kaminoan droid]]s, allowing the Republic to defend the village against Boorka and Confederacy's forces.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{EastereggLegends}}
The Jundland Station was a location in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. It is encountered in the third Galactic Republic campaign mission, "Never Trust a Hutt". Although technically a side quest, the Jundland Station's request to destroy the Tuskens must be completed to get the necessary resources to create enough forces to win the mission without the use of cheat codes. To complete the side quest the player is required to either wipe out or [[Mind trick/Legends|turn]] every man, woman, and child in the Tusken village to the east of Jundland Station, and also destroy their buildings. As such, it may be presumed that the whole Tusken settlement was wiped out by Echuu's forces.

The other version of the "Jundland Station" was accessible via a bonus mission in the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]] mission of the Wookiee Campaign. Because of this as well as the presence of Tusken Raiders and a desert environment, it was left ambiguous as to whether the location was at Kashyyyk or at Tatooine.

In this version, Jundland Station was a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] camp. It was either located at the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], or was otherwise named after it.

[[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by the Tusken Raiders after they had somehow captured her when she landed in close proximity. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], alongside an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] named [[Simon (Ewok)|Simon]], staged a [[Rescue at Jundland Station|rescue]] of Amidala, successfully doing so before she was beaten to death by her captors.

While escorting the Queen back to the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]], also killing the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] when she attempted to stop them, the trio ended up ambushed by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], but they successfully vanquished him.

The location, like the mission it appeared in, is likewise assumed to be non-canon until stated otherwise, due to the presence of characters long dead by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] (the date of the Liberation of Kashyyyk according to ''The Essential Atlas'' and ''Galactic Battlegrounds'') such as Padmé Amidala, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Qui-Gon Jinn.
